Healthy Resource

–
Healthy resource
–
Not overfished
–
Overfishing not occurring

11
Certified Sustainable
Sustainable Practices
•
Typical by-catch is less than 1%
•
Use a net mesh that allows smaller and immature
fish to escape
•
The natural spawning cycle is protected by limiting
harvest from April through October.
•
Weekend fishing and fishing in popular recreational
waters are voluntarily restricted.
•
Illegal, unregulated, and unreported (IUU) fish are
banned from our processes.
CERTIFIED AND AWARDED
•
Omega Protein is certified sustainable by
Friend of the Sea, an organization dedicated
to the preservation of marine resources.
•
Awarded most sustainable fishery in the FOS
organization in 2008
